-- The substitution theory of the syntax: substituting a renaming, the
-- identity, the three fusions and extensionality (Thms 5.1-5.5), and the
-- one-variable and one-lock laws the logical relation uses (5.6).
--
-- A substitution acts on a term through two things only, exactly as a
-- renaming does (Metatheory.Renaming): its action on neutrals subNe σ
-- (into VALUES) and its world map toW (wmS σ).  So the method is
-- Renaming's: every theorem is stated over an ARBITRARY path of source
-- telescopes e, with a path of terms over it, and a record says what the
-- two sides do on neutrals (on-ne) and on worlds (on-world):
--
--   AgreeSR e σ ρ          σ acts as the renaming ρ     subNe σ ≡[e] ne ∘ renNe ρ
--   AgreeSS e σ₁ σ₂        σ₁ and σ₂ agree              subNe σ₁ ≡[e] subNe σ₂
--   CompRS e ρ σ σ'        ρ then σ is σ'               subNe σ ∘ renNe ρ ≡[e] subNe σ'
--   CompSR e σ ρ σ'        σ then ρ is σ'               renV ρ ∘ subNe σ ≡[e] subNe σ'
--   CompSS e σ₁ σ₂ σ₁₂     σ₁ then σ₂ is σ₁₂            subV σ₂ ∘ subNe σ₁ ≡[e] subNe σ₁₂
--
-- with the matching equation of world maps in W.  For X = V, Vs, C:
--
--   5.1  sub-agree-ren  AgreeSR e σ ρ → t ≡[e] t' → subX σ t ≡ renX ρ t'
--        sub-ren        subX ⌜ ρ ⌝ t ≡ renX ρ t          sub-id   subX idS t ≡ t
--   5.2  sub-ren-fuse   CompRS e ρ σ σ' → t ≡[e] t' → subX σ (renX ρ t) ≡ subX σ' t'
--   5.3  ren-sub-fuse   CompSR e σ ρ σ' → t ≡[e] t' → renX ρ (subX σ t) ≡ subX σ' t'
--   5.4  sub-fuse       CompSS e σ₁ σ₂ σ₁₂ → t ≡[e] t' → subX σ₂ (subX σ₁ t) ≡ subX σ₁₂ t'
--   5.5  sub-ext        AgreeSS e σ₁ σ₂ → t₁ ≡[e] t₂ → subX σ₁ t₁ ≡ subX σ₂ t₂
--
-- CLOSURE.  Inside the induction a substitution is lifted under a variable
-- (liftS σ), under a lock (lockₛ σ q idR) and along a word (liftWS).  On
-- neutrals the lifted substitution acts as σ, lifted:
--
--   liftV,      here ↦ here,  wkv n ↦ wkV (σ n)                    (wkS-ne)
--   liftV⧀ q    up n ↦ ↑V q (σ n),  opn n ↦ openV (σ n) q,  nm k ↦ nm k
--
-- so each closure lemma moves the lifted equation of actions along the
-- lifted path, and its two ends are the one-variable and one-lock laws:
--
--   renV (keep ρ) ∘ wkV ≡ wkV ∘ renV ρ           subV (liftS σ) ∘ wkV ≡ wkV ∘ subV σ
--   renV (keepL ρ q) ∘ ↑V ≡ ↑V q ∘ renV ρ        subV (lockₛ σ q idR) ∘ ↑V ≡ ↑V q ∘ subV σ   (sub-↑)
--   the same for openV                            (ren-openV, sub-openV)
--
-- The ↑V laws are the strength's naturality ι (pos f p) ⋆ smap f p ≡ f ⋆ ι p
-- (the N-hom of LockKind.str).  Positions and world maps move together in
-- Ey κ w x, as in Renaming.  liftS σ = wkS σ ,ₛ ne here has world map
-- wmS (wkS σ), which is wmS σ only propositionally (wmS-wkS).
--
-- POST-WEAKENING.  σ ↑ˢ p : Sub Θ (Δ ⧀⟨ κ , p ⟩) is σ followed by
-- crossing the lock (↑V p), and ↑ˢW its iterate along a word.  They are
-- the third substitutions of the composites that prove sub-↑ and sub-dropW.
--
-- Transport is never computed on Ne, Val or Comp; J is only used to
-- produce paths.
open import Cubical.Foundations.Prelude hiding (Sub; _,_; comp)
open import Cubical.Data.Sigma using (Σ-syntax) renaming (_,_ to _,ˢ_)
open import Cubical.Data.List using (List; []; _∷_)
open import Cubical.Categories.Category using (Category; _[_,_])
open import Cubical.Categories.NaturalTransformation using (NatTrans)

open import RMRCanonicity.PRACBPVGeneric.Signature

module RMRCanonicity.PRACBPVGeneric.Metatheory.Substitution
  {W : Category ℓ-zero ℓ-zero} (L : LockSig W) (O : OpSig L) where

open import RMRCanonicity.PRACBPVGeneric.Syntax L O
open import RMRCanonicity.PRACBPVGeneric.Reduction L O using (dropW)
open import RMRCanonicity.PRACBPVGeneric.Metatheory.Renaming L O

open NatTrans
open Composite

private
  module W = Category W

----------------------------------------------------------------------
-- world maps: the strength's naturality, and positions under a lock

-- the strength is natural (the N-hom of LockKind.str, at one position)
ι-nat : ∀ κ {w w'} (f : W [ w , w' ]) (p : Pos κ w') →
  ι κ w (pos κ f p) W.⋆ smap κ f p ≡ f W.⋆ ι κ w' p
ι-nat κ f p i = LockKind.str (kind κ) .N-hom f i .snd p

ι-natW : ∀ κ {w w'} (g : WMap w w') (p : Pos κ w') →
  ι κ w (posW κ g p) W.⋆ toW (smapW κ g p) ≡ toW g W.⋆ ι κ w' p
ι-natW κ idW p = W.⋆IdR _ ∙ sym (W.⋆IdL _)
ι-natW κ (mapW f) p = ι-nat κ f p

cmapW-agree : ∀ {w w' b} (g g' : WMap w w') → toW g ≡ toW g' → (c : Cst b w) →
  cmapW g c ≡ cmapW g' c
cmapW-agree g g' r c = cmapW-seq idW g g' (W.⋆IdL (toW g) ∙ r) c

-- the position path under a lock, for world maps that agree
pt-agree : ∀ κ {w₁ w₂ w} {ew : w₁ ≡ w₂} (g₁ : WMap w₁ w) (g₂ : WMap w₂ w) →
  PathP (λ i → W [ ew i , w ]) (toW g₁) (toW g₂) → (q : Pos κ w) →
  PathP (λ i → Ey κ (ew i) (scope κ w q)) (ptW κ g₁ q) (ptW κ g₂ q)
pt-agree κ g₁ g₂ r q = ptW-toW κ g₁ q ◁ (λ i → pt κ (r i) q) ▷ sym (ptW-toW κ g₂ q)

-- the position path under a lock, for a composite of world maps
pt-comp : ∀ κ {w₁ w₁' w₂ w₃} {ew : w₁ ≡ w₁'}
  (g₁ : WMap w₁ w₂) (g₂ : WMap w₂ w₃) (g₁₂ : WMap w₁' w₃) →
  PathP (λ i → W [ ew i , w₃ ]) (toW g₁ W.⋆ toW g₂) (toW g₁₂) → (q : Pos κ w₃) →
  PathP (λ i → Ey κ (ew i) (scope κ w₃ q))
    (posW κ g₁ (posW κ g₂ q) ,ˢ toW (smapW κ g₁ (posW κ g₂ q)) W.⋆ toW (smapW κ g₂ q))
    (ptW κ g₁₂ q)
pt-comp κ g₁ g₂ g₁₂ r q = ptW-seq κ g₁ g₂ q ◁ (λ i → pt κ (r i) q) ▷ sym (ptW-toW κ g₁₂ q)

----------------------------------------------------------------------
-- renaming across one variable and one lock (instances of ren-fuse)

private
  -- drop idR then keep ρ, and ρ then drop idR, are both drop ρ
  keep-wk : ∀ {Θ Θ' B} (ρ : Ren Θ Θ') → Composite refl (drop {A = B} idR) (keep ρ) (drop ρ)
  keep-wk ρ .on-ne = refl
  keep-wk ρ .on-world = W.⋆IdL _

  wk-after : ∀ {Θ Θ' B} (ρ : Ren Θ Θ') → Composite refl ρ (drop {A = B} idR) (drop ρ)
  wk-after ρ .on-ne = refl
  wk-after ρ .on-world = W.⋆IdR _

  -- dropL idR then keepL ρ q, and ρ then dropL idR q, are both dropL ρ q
  keepL-up : ∀ {Δ Δ' κ} (ρ : Ren Δ Δ') (q : Pos κ (world Δ')) →
    Composite refl (dropL idR (posW κ (wm ρ) q)) (keepL ρ q) (dropL ρ q)
  keepL-up ρ q .on-ne = refl
  keepL-up {κ = κ} ρ q .on-world = ι-natW κ (wm ρ) q ∙ sym (toW-⋆ (wm ρ) (mapW _))

  up-after : ∀ {Θ Δ' κ} (ρ : Ren Θ Δ') (q : Pos κ (world Δ')) →
    Composite refl ρ (dropL idR q) (dropL ρ q)
  up-after ρ q .on-ne = refl
  up-after ρ q .on-world = sym (toW-⋆ (wm ρ) (mapW _))

ren-keep-wkV : ∀ {Θ Θ' A B} (ρ : Ren Θ Θ') (V : Val Θ A) →
  renV (keep {A = B} ρ) (wkV V) ≡ wkV (renV ρ V)
ren-keep-wkV ρ V = ren-fuseV (keep-wk ρ) V refl ∙ sym (ren-fuseV (wk-after ρ) V refl)

ren-keepL-↑ : ∀ {Δ Δ' κ A} (ρ : Ren Δ Δ') (q : Pos κ (world Δ')) (V : Val Δ A) →
  renV (keepL ρ q) (↑V (posW κ (wm ρ) q) V) ≡ ↑V q (renV ρ V)
ren-keepL-↑ ρ q V = ren-fuseV (keepL-up ρ q) V refl ∙ sym (ren-fuseV (up-after ρ q) V refl)

-- 5.6: renaming under a lock commutes with open (by cases: open resolves at shut)
ren-openV : ∀ {Δ Δ' κ A} (ρ : Ren Δ Δ') (q : Pos κ (world Δ')) (V : Val Δ ([ κ ] A)) →
  renV (keepL ρ q) (openV V (posW κ (wm ρ) q)) ≡ openV (renV ρ V) q
ren-openV ρ q (ne n) = refl
ren-openV ρ q (shut V) = refl

----------------------------------------------------------------------
-- weakening a substitution, and post-weakening across a lock

-- 5.6
wkS-ne : ∀ {Θ Θ' A B} (σ : Sub Θ Θ') (n : Ne Θ A) → subNe (wkS {A = B} σ) n ≡ wkV (subNe σ n)
wkS-ne ⌜ ρ ⌝ n = refl
wkS-ne (σ ,ₛ V) here = refl
wkS-ne (σ ,ₛ V) (wkv n) = wkS-ne σ n
wkS-ne (lockₛ σ p τ) (up n) = sym (ren-fuseV (wk-after τ) _ refl)
wkS-ne (lockₛ σ p τ) (opn n) = sym (ren-fuseV (wk-after τ) _ refl)
wkS-ne (lockₛ σ p τ) (nm k) = refl
wkS-ne (close p f) (up ())
wkS-ne (close p f) (opn ())
wkS-ne (close p f) (nm k) = refl

wmS-wkS : ∀ {Θ Θ' B} (σ : Sub Θ Θ') → wmS (wkS {A = B} σ) ≡ wmS σ
wmS-wkS ⌜ ρ ⌝ = refl
wmS-wkS (σ ,ₛ V) = wmS-wkS σ
wmS-wkS (lockₛ σ p τ) = refl
wmS-wkS (close p f) = refl

-- σ, then across the lock at p
infixl 6 _↑ˢ_

_↑ˢ_ : ∀ {Θ Δ κ} → Sub Θ Δ → (p : Pos κ (world Δ)) → Sub Θ (Δ ⧀⟨ κ , p ⟩)
⌜ ρ ⌝ ↑ˢ p = ⌜ dropL ρ p ⌝
(σ ,ₛ V) ↑ˢ p = (σ ↑ˢ p) ,ₛ ↑V p V
lockₛ σ q τ ↑ˢ p = lockₛ σ q (dropL τ p)
_↑ˢ_ {Δ = Δ} {κ = κ} (close q f) p = close q (f ⋆W mapW (ι κ (world Δ) p))

-- 5.6
↑ˢ-ne : ∀ {Θ Δ κ A} (σ : Sub Θ Δ) (p : Pos κ (world Δ)) (n : Ne Θ A) →
  subNe (σ ↑ˢ p) n ≡ ↑V p (subNe σ n)
↑ˢ-ne ⌜ ρ ⌝ p n = refl
↑ˢ-ne (σ ,ₛ V) p here = refl
↑ˢ-ne (σ ,ₛ V) p (wkv n) = ↑ˢ-ne σ p n
↑ˢ-ne (lockₛ σ q τ) p (up n) = sym (ren-fuseV (up-after τ p) _ refl)
↑ˢ-ne (lockₛ σ q τ) p (opn n) = sym (ren-fuseV (up-after τ p) _ refl)
↑ˢ-ne (lockₛ σ q τ) p (nm k) = refl
↑ˢ-ne (close q f) p (up ())
↑ˢ-ne (close q f) p (opn ())
↑ˢ-ne (close q f) p (nm k) =
  cong const (sym (cmapW-seq f (mapW _) (f ⋆W mapW _) (sym (toW-⋆ f (mapW _))) _))

wmS-↑ˢ : ∀ {Θ Δ κ} (σ : Sub Θ Δ) (p : Pos κ (world Δ)) →
  toW (wmS (σ ↑ˢ p)) ≡ toW (wmS σ) W.⋆ ι κ (world Δ) p
wmS-↑ˢ ⌜ ρ ⌝ p = toW-⋆ (wm ρ) (mapW _)
wmS-↑ˢ (σ ,ₛ V) p = wmS-↑ˢ σ p
wmS-↑ˢ (lockₛ {κ = κ'} σ q τ) p =
  toW-⋆ (smapW κ' (wmS σ) q) (wm τ ⋆W mapW _)
  ∙ cong (toW (smapW κ' (wmS σ) q) W.⋆_) (toW-⋆ (wm τ) (mapW _))
  ∙ sym (W.⋆Assoc _ _ _)
  ∙ cong (W._⋆ _) (sym (toW-⋆ (smapW κ' (wmS σ) q) (wm τ)))
wmS-↑ˢ (close q f) p = toW-⋆ f (mapW _)

----------------------------------------------------------------------
-- the actions of lifted substitutions on neutrals

-- under a variable
liftV, : ∀ {Δ Δ' B} → (∀ {A} → Ne Δ A → Val Δ' A) → ∀ {A} → Ne (Δ , B) A → Val (Δ' , B) A
liftV, f here = ne here
liftV, f (wkv n) = wkV (f n)

-- under a lock: up crosses it, opn opens, names stay
liftV⧀ : ∀ {Δ Δ'} κ {p} (q : Pos κ (world Δ')) → (∀ {A} → Ne Δ A → Val Δ' A) →
  ∀ {A} → Ne (Δ ⧀⟨ κ , p ⟩) A → Val (Δ' ⧀⟨ κ , q ⟩) A
liftV⧀ κ q f (up n) = ↑V q (f n)
liftV⧀ κ q f (opn n) = openV (f n) q
liftV⧀ κ q f (nm k) = ne (nm k)

subNe-liftS : ∀ {Θ Θ' B A} (σ : Sub Θ Θ') (n : Ne (Θ , B) A) →
  subNe (liftS σ) n ≡ liftV, (subNe σ) n
subNe-liftS σ here = refl
subNe-liftS σ (wkv n) = wkS-ne σ n

subNe-lockₛ : ∀ {Δ Δ' κ A} (σ : Sub Δ Δ') (q : Pos κ (world Δ'))
  (n : Ne (Δ ⧀⟨ κ , posW κ (wmS σ) q ⟩) A) → subNe (lockₛ σ q idR) n ≡ liftV⧀ κ q (subNe σ) n
subNe-lockₛ σ q (up n) = ren-idV _
subNe-lockₛ σ q (opn n) = ren-idV _
subNe-lockₛ σ q (nm k) = refl

private
  ne-keep : ∀ {Θ Θ' B A} (ρ : Ren Θ Θ') (n : Ne (Θ , B) A) →
    ne (renNe (keep ρ) n) ≡ liftV, (λ m → ne (renNe ρ m)) n
  ne-keep ρ here = refl
  ne-keep ρ (wkv n) = refl

  ne-keepL : ∀ {Δ Δ' κ A} (ρ : Ren Δ Δ') (q : Pos κ (world Δ'))
    (n : Ne (Δ ⧀⟨ κ , posW κ (wm ρ) q ⟩) A) →
    ne (renNe (keepL ρ q) n) ≡ liftV⧀ κ q (λ m → ne (renNe ρ m)) n
  ne-keepL ρ q (up n) = refl
  ne-keepL ρ q (opn n) = refl
  ne-keepL ρ q (nm k) = refl

----------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 5.1: a substitution that acts as a renaming

record AgreeSR {Θ₁ Θ₂ Θ'} (e : Θ₁ ≡ Θ₂) (σ : Sub Θ₁ Θ') (ρ : Ren Θ₂ Θ') : Type where
  field
    on-ne : ∀ {A} → PathP (λ i → Ne (e i) A → Val Θ' A) (subNe σ) (λ n → ne (renNe ρ n))
    on-world : PathP (λ i → W [ world (e i) , world Θ' ]) (toW (wmS σ)) (toW (wm ρ))

open AgreeSR

-- ⌜ ρ ⌝ acts as ρ
AgreeSR-ren : ∀ {Θ Θ'} (ρ : Ren Θ Θ') → AgreeSR refl ⌜ ρ ⌝ ρ
AgreeSR-ren ρ .on-ne = refl
AgreeSR-ren ρ .on-world = refl

module _ {Θ₁ Θ₂ Θ'} {e : Θ₁ ≡ Θ₂} {σ : Sub Θ₁ Θ'} {ρ : Ren Θ₂ Θ'} where

  AgreeSR-keep : ∀ {B} → AgreeSR e σ ρ → AgreeSR (λ i → e i , B) (liftS σ) (keep ρ)
  AgreeSR-keep ag .on-ne =
    funExt (subNe-liftS σ) ◁ (λ i → liftV, (λ {A} → ag .on-ne {A} i)) ▷ sym (funExt (ne-keep ρ))
  AgreeSR-keep ag .on-world = cong toW (wmS-wkS σ) ◁ ag .on-world

  AgreeSR-pt : ∀ {κ} → AgreeSR e σ ρ → (q : Pos κ (world Θ')) →
    PathP (λ i → Ey κ (world (e i)) (scope κ (world Θ') q)) (ptW κ (wmS σ) q) (ptW κ (wm ρ) q)
  AgreeSR-pt {κ} ag q = pt-agree κ (wmS σ) (wm ρ) (ag .on-world) q

  AgreeSR-lock : ∀ {κ} (ag : AgreeSR e σ ρ) (q : Pos κ (world Θ')) →
    AgreeSR (λ i → e i ⧀⟨ κ , AgreeSR-pt ag q i .fst ⟩) (lockₛ σ q idR) (keepL ρ q)
  AgreeSR-lock {κ} ag q .on-ne =
    funExt (subNe-lockₛ σ q)
    ◁ (λ i → liftV⧀ κ {p = AgreeSR-pt ag q i .fst} q (λ {A} → ag .on-ne {A} i))
    ▷ sym (funExt (ne-keepL ρ q))
  AgreeSR-lock ag q .on-world i = AgreeSR-pt ag q i .snd

AgreeSR-pts : ∀ {Θ₁ Θ₂ Θ'} {e : Θ₁ ≡ Θ₂} {σ : Sub Θ₁ Θ'} {ρ : Ren Θ₂ Θ'} (μ : List Lk) →
  AgreeSR e σ ρ → (ps : WPos μ (world Θ')) →
  PathP (λ i → WPos μ (world (e i))) (wposW μ (wmS σ) ps) (wposW μ (wm ρ) ps)
AgreeSR-pts [] ag ps = refl
AgreeSR-pts (κ ∷ []) ag p i = AgreeSR-pt ag p i .fst
AgreeSR-pts (κ ∷ μ@(_ ∷ _)) ag (p ,ˢ ps) i =
  AgreeSR-pt ag p i .fst ,ˢ AgreeSR-pts μ (AgreeSR-lock ag p) ps i

AgreeSR-W : ∀ {Θ₁ Θ₂ Θ'} {e : Θ₁ ≡ Θ₂} {σ : Sub Θ₁ Θ'} {ρ : Ren Θ₂ Θ'} (μ : List Lk)
  (ag : AgreeSR e σ ρ) (ps : WPos μ (world Θ')) →
  AgreeSR (λ i → e i ⧀*⟨ μ , AgreeSR-pts μ ag ps i ⟩) (liftWS μ σ ps) (keepW μ ρ ps)
AgreeSR-W [] ag ps = ag
AgreeSR-W (κ ∷ []) ag p = AgreeSR-lock ag p
AgreeSR-W (κ ∷ μ@(_ ∷ _)) ag (p ,ˢ ps) = AgreeSR-W μ (AgreeSR-lock ag p) ps

sub-agree-renV : ∀ {Θ₁ Θ₂ Θ' A} {e : Θ₁ ≡ Θ₂} {σ : Sub Θ₁ Θ'} {ρ : Ren Θ₂ Θ'} → AgreeSR e σ ρ →
  (t : Val Θ₁ A) {t' : Val Θ₂ A} → PathP (λ i → Val (e i) A) t t' → subV σ t ≡ renV ρ t'
sub-agree-renVs : ∀ {Θ₁ Θ₂ Θ' bs} {e : Θ₁ ≡ Θ₂} {σ : Sub Θ₁ Θ'} {ρ : Ren Θ₂ Θ'} → AgreeSR e σ ρ →
  (t : Vals Θ₁ bs) {t' : Vals Θ₂ bs} → PathP (λ i → Vals (e i) bs) t t' → subVs σ t ≡ renVs ρ t'
sub-agree-renC : ∀ {Θ₁ Θ₂ Θ' B} {e : Θ₁ ≡ Θ₂} {σ : Sub Θ₁ Θ'} {ρ : Ren Θ₂ Θ'} → AgreeSR e σ ρ →
  (t : Comp Θ₁ B) {t' : Comp Θ₂ B} → PathP (λ i → Comp (e i) B) t t' → subC σ t ≡ renC ρ t'

-- the same telescope and the same term: induction on the term
private
  agV : ∀ {Θ Θ' A} {σ : Sub Θ Θ'} {ρ : Ren Θ Θ'} → AgreeSR refl σ ρ → (t : Val Θ A) →
    subV σ t ≡ renV ρ t
  agVs : ∀ {Θ Θ' bs} {σ : Sub Θ Θ'} {ρ : Ren Θ Θ'} → AgreeSR refl σ ρ → (t : Vals Θ bs) →
    subVs σ t ≡ renVs ρ t
  agC : ∀ {Θ Θ' B} {σ : Sub Θ Θ'} {ρ : Ren Θ Θ'} → AgreeSR refl σ ρ → (t : Comp Θ B) →
    subC σ t ≡ renC ρ t

  agV ag (ne n) i = ag .on-ne i n
  agV ag tt = refl
  agV ag (inl V) = cong inl (agV ag V)
  agV ag (inr V) = cong inr (agV ag V)
  agV ag (pair V V') = cong₂ pair (agV ag V) (agV ag V')
  agV ag (thunk M) = cong thunk (agC ag M)
  agV {σ = σ} {ρ} ag (const c) = cong const (cmapW-agree (wmS σ) (wm ρ) (ag .on-world) c)
  agV ag (shut V) = cong shut (funExt λ q →
    sub-agree-renV (AgreeSR-lock ag q) (V _) (λ i → V (AgreeSR-pt ag q i .fst)))

  agVs ag []ᵥ = refl
  agVs ag (V ∷ᵥ vs) = cong₂ _∷ᵥ_ (agV ag V) (agVs ag vs)

  agC ag (return V) = cong return (agV ag V)
  agC ag (M to N) = cong₂ _to_ (agC ag M) (agC (AgreeSR-keep ag) N)
  agC ag (force V) = cong force (agV ag V)
  agC ag (case V M) = cong₂ case (agV ag V) (agC (AgreeSR-keep (AgreeSR-keep ag)) M)
  agC ag (case₊ V M N) =
    cong₃ case₊ (agV ag V) (agC (AgreeSR-keep ag) M) (agC (AgreeSR-keep ag) N)
  agC ag (absurd V) = cong absurd (agV ag V)
  agC ag (lam M) = cong lam (agC (AgreeSR-keep ag) M)
  agC ag (app M V) = cong₂ app (agC ag M) (agV ag V)
  agC ag (op o vs k) = cong₂ (op o) (agVs ag vs) (funExt λ a → funExt λ ps →
    sub-agree-renC (AgreeSR-W (slot o a) ag ps) (k a _) (λ i → k a (AgreeSR-pts (slot o a) ag ps i)))

sub-agree-renV {Θ₁} {Θ' = Θ'} {A = A} {σ = σ} ag t tp =
  J-tele (λ Θ → Val Θ A) (λ Θ₂ e' t' → (ρ : Ren Θ₂ Θ') → AgreeSR e' σ ρ → subV σ t ≡ renV ρ t')
    (λ ρ ag' → agV ag' t) _ tp _ ag
sub-agree-renVs {Θ₁} {Θ' = Θ'} {bs = bs} {σ = σ} ag t tp =
  J-tele (λ Θ → Vals Θ bs) (λ Θ₂ e' t' → (ρ : Ren Θ₂ Θ') → AgreeSR e' σ ρ → subVs σ t ≡ renVs ρ t')
    (λ ρ ag' → agVs ag' t) _ tp _ ag
sub-agree-renC {Θ₁} {Θ' = Θ'} {B = B} {σ = σ} ag t tp =
  J-tele (λ Θ → Comp Θ B) (λ Θ₂ e' t' → (ρ : Ren Θ₂ Θ') → AgreeSR e' σ ρ → subC σ t ≡ renC ρ t')
    (λ ρ ag' → agC ag' t) _ tp _ ag

-- substituting a renaming is renaming
sub-renV : ∀ {Θ Θ' A} (ρ : Ren Θ Θ') (t : Val Θ A) → subV ⌜ ρ ⌝ t ≡ renV ρ t
sub-renV ρ t = sub-agree-renV (AgreeSR-ren ρ) t refl

sub-renVs : ∀ {Θ Θ' bs} (ρ : Ren Θ Θ') (t : Vals Θ bs) → subVs ⌜ ρ ⌝ t ≡ renVs ρ t
sub-renVs ρ t = sub-agree-renVs (AgreeSR-ren ρ) t refl

sub-renC : ∀ {Θ Θ' B} (ρ : Ren Θ Θ') (t : Comp Θ B) → subC ⌜ ρ ⌝ t ≡ renC ρ t
sub-renC ρ t = sub-agree-renC (AgreeSR-ren ρ) t refl

-- the identity substitution
sub-idV : ∀ {Θ A} (t : Val Θ A) → subV idS t ≡ t
sub-idV t = sub-renV idR t ∙ ren-idV t

sub-idVs : ∀ {Θ bs} (t : Vals Θ bs) → subVs idS t ≡ t
sub-idVs t = sub-renVs idR t ∙ ren-idVs t

sub-idC : ∀ {Θ B} (t : Comp Θ B) → subC idS t ≡ t
sub-idC t = sub-renC idR t ∙ ren-idC t

----------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 5.2: a renaming, then a substitution

record CompRS {Θ₁ Θ₁' Θ₂ Θ₃} (e : Θ₁ ≡ Θ₁')
  (ρ : Ren Θ₁ Θ₂) (σ : Sub Θ₂ Θ₃) (σ' : Sub Θ₁' Θ₃) : Type where
  field
    on-ne : ∀ {A} → PathP (λ i → Ne (e i) A → Val Θ₃ A) (λ n → subNe σ (renNe ρ n)) (subNe σ')
    on-world : PathP (λ i → W [ world (e i) , world Θ₃ ])
      (toW (wm ρ) W.⋆ toW (wmS σ)) (toW (wmS σ'))

open CompRS

module _ {Θ₁ Θ₁' Θ₂ Θ₃} {e : Θ₁ ≡ Θ₁'} {ρ : Ren Θ₁ Θ₂} {σ : Sub Θ₂ Θ₃} {σ' : Sub Θ₁' Θ₃} where

  private
    keep-ne : ∀ {B A} (n : Ne (Θ₁ , B) A) →
      subNe (liftS σ) (renNe (keep ρ) n) ≡ liftV, (λ m → subNe σ (renNe ρ m)) n
    keep-ne here = refl
    keep-ne (wkv n) = wkS-ne σ (renNe ρ n)

    lock-ne : ∀ {κ A} (q : Pos κ (world Θ₃))
      (n : Ne (Θ₁ ⧀⟨ κ , posW κ (wm ρ) (posW κ (wmS σ) q) ⟩) A) →
      subNe (lockₛ σ q idR) (renNe (keepL ρ (posW κ (wmS σ) q)) n)
        ≡ liftV⧀ κ q (λ m → subNe σ (renNe ρ m)) n
    lock-ne q (up n) = ren-idV _
    lock-ne q (opn n) = ren-idV _
    lock-ne q (nm k) = refl

  CompRS-keep : ∀ {B} → CompRS e ρ σ σ' → CompRS (λ i → e i , B) (keep ρ) (liftS σ) (liftS σ')
  CompRS-keep c .on-ne =
    funExt keep-ne ◁ (λ i → liftV, (λ {A} → c .on-ne {A} i)) ▷ sym (funExt (subNe-liftS σ'))
  CompRS-keep c .on-world =
    cong (λ g → toW (wm ρ) W.⋆ toW g) (wmS-wkS σ) ◁ c .on-world ▷ cong toW (sym (wmS-wkS σ'))

  CompRS-pt : ∀ {κ} → CompRS e ρ σ σ' → (q : Pos κ (world Θ₃)) →
    PathP (λ i → Ey κ (world (e i)) (scope κ (world Θ₃) q))
      (posW κ (wm ρ) (posW κ (wmS σ) q) ,ˢ
        toW (smapW κ (wm ρ) (posW κ (wmS σ) q)) W.⋆ toW (smapW κ (wmS σ) q))
      (ptW κ (wmS σ') q)
  CompRS-pt {κ} c q = pt-comp κ (wm ρ) (wmS σ) (wmS σ') (c .on-world) q

  CompRS-lock : ∀ {κ} (c : CompRS e ρ σ σ') (q : Pos κ (world Θ₃)) →
    CompRS (λ i → e i ⧀⟨ κ , CompRS-pt c q i .fst ⟩)
      (keepL ρ (posW κ (wmS σ) q)) (lockₛ σ q idR) (lockₛ σ' q idR)
  CompRS-lock {κ} c q .on-ne =
    funExt (lock-ne q)
    ◁ (λ i → liftV⧀ κ {p = CompRS-pt c q i .fst} q (λ {A} → c .on-ne {A} i))
    ▷ sym (funExt (subNe-lockₛ σ' q))
  CompRS-lock c q .on-world i = CompRS-pt c q i .snd

CompRS-pts : ∀ {Θ₁ Θ₁' Θ₂ Θ₃} {e : Θ₁ ≡ Θ₁'} {ρ : Ren Θ₁ Θ₂} {σ : Sub Θ₂ Θ₃} {σ' : Sub Θ₁' Θ₃}
  (μ : List Lk) → CompRS e ρ σ σ' → (ps : WPos μ (world Θ₃)) →
  PathP (λ i → WPos μ (world (e i))) (wposW μ (wm ρ) (wposW μ (wmS σ) ps)) (wposW μ (wmS σ') ps)
CompRS-pts [] c ps = refl
CompRS-pts (κ ∷ []) c p i = CompRS-pt c p i .fst
CompRS-pts (κ ∷ μ@(_ ∷ _)) c (p ,ˢ ps) i =
  CompRS-pt c p i .fst ,ˢ CompRS-pts μ (CompRS-lock c p) ps i

CompRS-W : ∀ {Θ₁ Θ₁' Θ₂ Θ₃} {e : Θ₁ ≡ Θ₁'} {ρ : Ren Θ₁ Θ₂} {σ : Sub Θ₂ Θ₃} {σ' : Sub Θ₁' Θ₃}
  (μ : List Lk) (c : CompRS e ρ σ σ') (ps : WPos μ (world Θ₃)) →
  CompRS (λ i → e i ⧀*⟨ μ , CompRS-pts μ c ps i ⟩)
    (keepW μ ρ (wposW μ (wmS σ) ps)) (liftWS μ σ ps) (liftWS μ σ' ps)
CompRS-W [] c ps = c
CompRS-W (κ ∷ []) c p = CompRS-lock c p
CompRS-W (κ ∷ μ@(_ ∷ _)) c (p ,ˢ ps) = CompRS-W μ (CompRS-lock c p) ps

sub-ren-fuseV : ∀ {Θ₁ Θ₁' Θ₂ Θ₃ A} {e : Θ₁ ≡ Θ₁'}
  {ρ : Ren Θ₁ Θ₂} {σ : Sub Θ₂ Θ₃} {σ' : Sub Θ₁' Θ₃} → CompRS e ρ σ σ' →
  (t : Val Θ₁ A) {t' : Val Θ₁' A} → PathP (λ i → Val (e i) A) t t' →
  subV σ (renV ρ t) ≡ subV σ' t'
sub-ren-fuseVs : ∀ {Θ₁ Θ₁' Θ₂ Θ₃ bs} {e : Θ₁ ≡ Θ₁'}
  {ρ : Ren Θ₁ Θ₂} {σ : Sub Θ₂ Θ₃} {σ' : Sub Θ₁' Θ₃} → CompRS e ρ σ σ' →
  (t : Vals Θ₁ bs) {t' : Vals Θ₁' bs} → PathP (λ i → Vals (e i) bs) t t' →
  subVs σ (renVs ρ t) ≡ subVs σ' t'
sub-ren-fuseC : ∀ {Θ₁ Θ₁' Θ₂ Θ₃ B} {e : Θ₁ ≡ Θ₁'}
  {ρ : Ren Θ₁ Θ₂} {σ : Sub Θ₂ Θ₃} {σ' : Sub Θ₁' Θ₃} → CompRS e ρ σ σ' →
  (t : Comp Θ₁ B) {t' : Comp Θ₁' B} → PathP (λ i → Comp (e i) B) t t' →
  subC σ (renC ρ t) ≡ subC σ' t'

private
  rsV : ∀ {Θ₁ Θ₂ Θ₃ A} {ρ : Ren Θ₁ Θ₂} {σ : Sub Θ₂ Θ₃} {σ' : Sub Θ₁ Θ₃} →
    CompRS refl ρ σ σ' → (t : Val Θ₁ A) → subV σ (renV ρ t) ≡ subV σ' t
  rsVs : ∀ {Θ₁ Θ₂ Θ₃ bs} {ρ : Ren Θ₁ Θ₂} {σ : Sub Θ₂ Θ₃} {σ' : Sub Θ₁ Θ₃} →
    CompRS refl ρ σ σ' → (t : Vals Θ₁ bs) → subVs σ (renVs ρ t) ≡ subVs σ' t
  rsC : ∀ {Θ₁ Θ₂ Θ₃ B} {ρ : Ren Θ₁ Θ₂} {σ : Sub Θ₂ Θ₃} {σ' : Sub Θ₁ Θ₃} →
    CompRS refl ρ σ σ' → (t : Comp Θ₁ B) → subC σ (renC ρ t) ≡ subC σ' t

  rsV c (ne n) i = c .on-ne i n
  rsV c tt = refl
  rsV c (inl V) = cong inl (rsV c V)
  rsV c (inr V) = cong inr (rsV c V)
  rsV c (pair V V') = cong₂ pair (rsV c V) (rsV c V')
  rsV c (thunk M) = cong thunk (rsC c M)
  rsV {ρ = ρ} {σ} {σ'} c (const x) = cong const (cmapW-seq (wm ρ) (wmS σ) (wmS σ') (c .on-world) x)
  rsV c (shut V) = cong shut (funExt λ q →
    sub-ren-fuseV (CompRS-lock c q) (V _) (λ i → V (CompRS-pt c q i .fst)))

  rsVs c []ᵥ = refl
  rsVs c (V ∷ᵥ vs) = cong₂ _∷ᵥ_ (rsV c V) (rsVs c vs)

  rsC c (return V) = cong return (rsV c V)
  rsC c (M to N) = cong₂ _to_ (rsC c M) (rsC (CompRS-keep c) N)
  rsC c (force V) = cong force (rsV c V)
  rsC c (case V M) = cong₂ case (rsV c V) (rsC (CompRS-keep (CompRS-keep c)) M)
  rsC c (case₊ V M N) =
    cong₃ case₊ (rsV c V) (rsC (CompRS-keep c) M) (rsC (CompRS-keep c) N)
  rsC c (absurd V) = cong absurd (rsV c V)
  rsC c (lam M) = cong lam (rsC (CompRS-keep c) M)
  rsC c (app M V) = cong₂ app (rsC c M) (rsV c V)
  rsC c (op o vs k) = cong₂ (op o) (rsVs c vs) (funExt λ a → funExt λ ps →
    sub-ren-fuseC (CompRS-W (slot o a) c ps) (k a _) (λ i → k a (CompRS-pts (slot o a) c ps i)))

sub-ren-fuseV {Θ₁} {Θ₃ = Θ₃} {A = A} {ρ = ρ} {σ} c t tp =
  J-tele (λ Θ → Val Θ A)
    (λ Θ' e' t' → (σ' : Sub Θ' Θ₃) → CompRS e' ρ σ σ' → subV σ (renV ρ t) ≡ subV σ' t')
    (λ σ' c' → rsV c' t) _ tp _ c
sub-ren-fuseVs {Θ₁} {Θ₃ = Θ₃} {bs = bs} {ρ = ρ} {σ} c t tp =
  J-tele (λ Θ → Vals Θ bs)
    (λ Θ' e' t' → (σ' : Sub Θ' Θ₃) → CompRS e' ρ σ σ' → subVs σ (renVs ρ t) ≡ subVs σ' t')
    (λ σ' c' → rsVs c' t) _ tp _ c
sub-ren-fuseC {Θ₁} {Θ₃ = Θ₃} {B = B} {ρ = ρ} {σ} c t tp =
  J-tele (λ Θ → Comp Θ B)
    (λ Θ' e' t' → (σ' : Sub Θ' Θ₃) → CompRS e' ρ σ σ' → subC σ (renC ρ t) ≡ subC σ' t')
    (λ σ' c' → rsC c' t) _ tp _ c

----------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 5.3: a substitution, then a renaming

record CompSR {Θ₁ Θ₁' Θ₂ Θ₃} (e : Θ₁ ≡ Θ₁')
  (σ : Sub Θ₁ Θ₂) (ρ : Ren Θ₂ Θ₃) (σ' : Sub Θ₁' Θ₃) : Type where
  field
    on-ne : ∀ {A} → PathP (λ i → Ne (e i) A → Val Θ₃ A) (λ n → renV ρ (subNe σ n)) (subNe σ')
    on-world : PathP (λ i → W [ world (e i) , world Θ₃ ])
      (toW (wmS σ) W.⋆ toW (wm ρ)) (toW (wmS σ'))

open CompSR

module _ {Θ₁ Θ₁' Θ₂ Θ₃} {e : Θ₁ ≡ Θ₁'} {σ : Sub Θ₁ Θ₂} {ρ : Ren Θ₂ Θ₃} {σ' : Sub Θ₁' Θ₃} where

  private
    keep-ne : ∀ {B A} (n : Ne (Θ₁ , B) A) →
      renV (keep ρ) (subNe (liftS σ) n) ≡ liftV, (λ m → renV ρ (subNe σ m)) n
    keep-ne here = refl
    keep-ne (wkv n) = cong (renV (keep ρ)) (wkS-ne σ n) ∙ ren-keep-wkV ρ (subNe σ n)

    lock-ne : ∀ {κ A} (q : Pos κ (world Θ₃))
      (n : Ne (Θ₁ ⧀⟨ κ , posW κ (wmS σ) (posW κ (wm ρ) q) ⟩) A) →
      renV (keepL ρ q) (subNe (lockₛ σ (posW κ (wm ρ) q) idR) n)
        ≡ liftV⧀ κ q (λ m → renV ρ (subNe σ m)) n
    lock-ne q (up n) = cong (renV (keepL ρ q)) (ren-idV _) ∙ ren-keepL-↑ ρ q (subNe σ n)
    lock-ne q (opn n) = cong (renV (keepL ρ q)) (ren-idV _) ∙ ren-openV ρ q (subNe σ n)
    lock-ne q (nm k) = refl

  CompSR-keep : ∀ {B} → CompSR e σ ρ σ' → CompSR (λ i → e i , B) (liftS σ) (keep ρ) (liftS σ')
  CompSR-keep c .on-ne =
    funExt keep-ne ◁ (λ i → liftV, (λ {A} → c .on-ne {A} i)) ▷ sym (funExt (subNe-liftS σ'))
  CompSR-keep c .on-world =
    cong (λ g → toW g W.⋆ toW (wm ρ)) (wmS-wkS σ) ◁ c .on-world ▷ cong toW (sym (wmS-wkS σ'))

  CompSR-pt : ∀ {κ} → CompSR e σ ρ σ' → (q : Pos κ (world Θ₃)) →
    PathP (λ i → Ey κ (world (e i)) (scope κ (world Θ₃) q))
      (posW κ (wmS σ) (posW κ (wm ρ) q) ,ˢ
        toW (smapW κ (wmS σ) (posW κ (wm ρ) q)) W.⋆ toW (smapW κ (wm ρ) q))
      (ptW κ (wmS σ') q)
  CompSR-pt {κ} c q = pt-comp κ (wmS σ) (wm ρ) (wmS σ') (c .on-world) q

  CompSR-lock : ∀ {κ} (c : CompSR e σ ρ σ') (q : Pos κ (world Θ₃)) →
    CompSR (λ i → e i ⧀⟨ κ , CompSR-pt c q i .fst ⟩)
      (lockₛ σ (posW κ (wm ρ) q) idR) (keepL ρ q) (lockₛ σ' q idR)
  CompSR-lock {κ} c q .on-ne =
    funExt (lock-ne q)
    ◁ (λ i → liftV⧀ κ {p = CompSR-pt c q i .fst} q (λ {A} → c .on-ne {A} i))
    ▷ sym (funExt (subNe-lockₛ σ' q))
  CompSR-lock c q .on-world i = CompSR-pt c q i .snd

CompSR-pts : ∀ {Θ₁ Θ₁' Θ₂ Θ₃} {e : Θ₁ ≡ Θ₁'} {σ : Sub Θ₁ Θ₂} {ρ : Ren Θ₂ Θ₃} {σ' : Sub Θ₁' Θ₃}
  (μ : List Lk) → CompSR e σ ρ σ' → (ps : WPos μ (world Θ₃)) →
  PathP (λ i → WPos μ (world (e i))) (wposW μ (wmS σ) (wposW μ (wm ρ) ps)) (wposW μ (wmS σ') ps)
CompSR-pts [] c ps = refl
CompSR-pts (κ ∷ []) c p i = CompSR-pt c p i .fst
CompSR-pts (κ ∷ μ@(_ ∷ _)) c (p ,ˢ ps) i =
  CompSR-pt c p i .fst ,ˢ CompSR-pts μ (CompSR-lock c p) ps i

CompSR-W : ∀ {Θ₁ Θ₁' Θ₂ Θ₃} {e : Θ₁ ≡ Θ₁'} {σ : Sub Θ₁ Θ₂} {ρ : Ren Θ₂ Θ₃} {σ' : Sub Θ₁' Θ₃}
  (μ : List Lk) (c : CompSR e σ ρ σ') (ps : WPos μ (world Θ₃)) →
  CompSR (λ i → e i ⧀*⟨ μ , CompSR-pts μ c ps i ⟩)
    (liftWS μ σ (wposW μ (wm ρ) ps)) (keepW μ ρ ps) (liftWS μ σ' ps)
CompSR-W [] c ps = c
CompSR-W (κ ∷ []) c p = CompSR-lock c p
CompSR-W (κ ∷ μ@(_ ∷ _)) c (p ,ˢ ps) = CompSR-W μ (CompSR-lock c p) ps

ren-sub-fuseV : ∀ {Θ₁ Θ₁' Θ₂ Θ₃ A} {e : Θ₁ ≡ Θ₁'}
  {σ : Sub Θ₁ Θ₂} {ρ : Ren Θ₂ Θ₃} {σ' : Sub Θ₁' Θ₃} → CompSR e σ ρ σ' →
  (t : Val Θ₁ A) {t' : Val Θ₁' A} → PathP (λ i → Val (e i) A) t t' →
  renV ρ (subV σ t) ≡ subV σ' t'
ren-sub-fuseVs : ∀ {Θ₁ Θ₁' Θ₂ Θ₃ bs} {e : Θ₁ ≡ Θ₁'}
  {σ : Sub Θ₁ Θ₂} {ρ : Ren Θ₂ Θ₃} {σ' : Sub Θ₁' Θ₃} → CompSR e σ ρ σ' →
  (t : Vals Θ₁ bs) {t' : Vals Θ₁' bs} → PathP (λ i → Vals (e i) bs) t t' →
  renVs ρ (subVs σ t) ≡ subVs σ' t'
ren-sub-fuseC : ∀ {Θ₁ Θ₁' Θ₂ Θ₃ B} {e : Θ₁ ≡ Θ₁'}
  {σ : Sub Θ₁ Θ₂} {ρ : Ren Θ₂ Θ₃} {σ' : Sub Θ₁' Θ₃} → CompSR e σ ρ σ' →
  (t : Comp Θ₁ B) {t' : Comp Θ₁' B} → PathP (λ i → Comp (e i) B) t t' →
  renC ρ (subC σ t) ≡ subC σ' t'

private
  srV : ∀ {Θ₁ Θ₂ Θ₃ A} {σ : Sub Θ₁ Θ₂} {ρ : Ren Θ₂ Θ₃} {σ' : Sub Θ₁ Θ₃} →
    CompSR refl σ ρ σ' → (t : Val Θ₁ A) → renV ρ (subV σ t) ≡ subV σ' t
  srVs : ∀ {Θ₁ Θ₂ Θ₃ bs} {σ : Sub Θ₁ Θ₂} {ρ : Ren Θ₂ Θ₃} {σ' : Sub Θ₁ Θ₃} →
    CompSR refl σ ρ σ' → (t : Vals Θ₁ bs) → renVs ρ (subVs σ t) ≡ subVs σ' t
  srC : ∀ {Θ₁ Θ₂ Θ₃ B} {σ : Sub Θ₁ Θ₂} {ρ : Ren Θ₂ Θ₃} {σ' : Sub Θ₁ Θ₃} →
    CompSR refl σ ρ σ' → (t : Comp Θ₁ B) → renC ρ (subC σ t) ≡ subC σ' t

  srV c (ne n) i = c .on-ne i n
  srV c tt = refl
  srV c (inl V) = cong inl (srV c V)
  srV c (inr V) = cong inr (srV c V)
  srV c (pair V V') = cong₂ pair (srV c V) (srV c V')
  srV c (thunk M) = cong thunk (srC c M)
  srV {σ = σ} {ρ} {σ'} c (const x) = cong const (cmapW-seq (wmS σ) (wm ρ) (wmS σ') (c .on-world) x)
  srV c (shut V) = cong shut (funExt λ q →
    ren-sub-fuseV (CompSR-lock c q) (V _) (λ i → V (CompSR-pt c q i .fst)))

  srVs c []ᵥ = refl
  srVs c (V ∷ᵥ vs) = cong₂ _∷ᵥ_ (srV c V) (srVs c vs)

  srC c (return V) = cong return (srV c V)
  srC c (M to N) = cong₂ _to_ (srC c M) (srC (CompSR-keep c) N)
  srC c (force V) = cong force (srV c V)
  srC c (case V M) = cong₂ case (srV c V) (srC (CompSR-keep (CompSR-keep c)) M)
  srC c (case₊ V M N) =
    cong₃ case₊ (srV c V) (srC (CompSR-keep c) M) (srC (CompSR-keep c) N)
  srC c (absurd V) = cong absurd (srV c V)
  srC c (lam M) = cong lam (srC (CompSR-keep c) M)
  srC c (app M V) = cong₂ app (srC c M) (srV c V)
  srC c (op o vs k) = cong₂ (op o) (srVs c vs) (funExt λ a → funExt λ ps →
    ren-sub-fuseC (CompSR-W (slot o a) c ps) (k a _) (λ i → k a (CompSR-pts (slot o a) c ps i)))

ren-sub-fuseV {Θ₁} {Θ₃ = Θ₃} {A = A} {σ = σ} {ρ} c t tp =
  J-tele (λ Θ → Val Θ A)
    (λ Θ' e' t' → (σ' : Sub Θ' Θ₃) → CompSR e' σ ρ σ' → renV ρ (subV σ t) ≡ subV σ' t')
    (λ σ' c' → srV c' t) _ tp _ c
ren-sub-fuseVs {Θ₁} {Θ₃ = Θ₃} {bs = bs} {σ = σ} {ρ} c t tp =
  J-tele (λ Θ → Vals Θ bs)
    (λ Θ' e' t' → (σ' : Sub Θ' Θ₃) → CompSR e' σ ρ σ' → renVs ρ (subVs σ t) ≡ subVs σ' t')
    (λ σ' c' → srVs c' t) _ tp _ c
ren-sub-fuseC {Θ₁} {Θ₃ = Θ₃} {B = B} {σ = σ} {ρ} c t tp =
  J-tele (λ Θ → Comp Θ B)
    (λ Θ' e' t' → (σ' : Sub Θ' Θ₃) → CompSR e' σ ρ σ' → renC ρ (subC σ t) ≡ subC σ' t')
    (λ σ' c' → srC c' t) _ tp _ c

----------------------------------------------------------------------
-- substitution across one variable and one lock (from 5.2 and 5.3)

-- substituting under a variable commutes with weakening
sub-liftS-wkV : ∀ {Θ Θ' A B} (σ : Sub Θ Θ') (V : Val Θ A) →
  subV (liftS {A = B} σ) (wkV V) ≡ wkV (subV σ V)
sub-liftS-wkV σ V = sub-ren-fuseV c₁ V refl ∙ sym (ren-sub-fuseV c₂ V refl)
  where
    c₁ : CompRS refl (drop idR) (liftS σ) (wkS σ)
    c₁ .on-ne = refl
    c₁ .on-world = W.⋆IdL _
    c₂ : CompSR refl σ (drop idR) (wkS σ)
    c₂ .on-ne = funExt λ n → sym (wkS-ne σ n)
    c₂ .on-world = W.⋆IdR _ ∙ cong toW (sym (wmS-wkS σ))

-- the substituted variable does not occur in a weakened term
sub-cons-wkV : ∀ {Θ Θ' A B} (σ : Sub Θ Θ') (V : Val Θ' B) (V' : Val Θ A) →
  subV (σ ,ₛ V) (wkV V') ≡ subV σ V'
sub-cons-wkV σ V V' = sub-ren-fuseV c V' refl
  where
    c : CompRS refl (drop idR) (σ ,ₛ V) σ
    c .on-ne = refl
    c .on-world = W.⋆IdL _

sub-cons-wkC : ∀ {Θ Θ' A B} (σ : Sub Θ Θ') (V : Val Θ' A) (M : Comp Θ B) →
  subC (σ ,ₛ V) (wkC M) ≡ subC σ M
sub-cons-wkC σ V M = sub-ren-fuseC c M refl
  where
    c : CompRS refl (drop idR) (σ ,ₛ V) σ
    c .on-ne = refl
    c .on-world = W.⋆IdL _

-- 5.6
sub-wkV : ∀ {Θ A B} (V : Val Θ B) (V' : Val Θ A) → subV (idS ,ₛ V) (wkV V') ≡ V'
sub-wkV V V' = sub-cons-wkV idS V V' ∙ sub-idV V'

sub-wkC : ∀ {Θ A B} (V : Val Θ A) (M : Comp Θ B) → subC (idS ,ₛ V) (wkC M) ≡ M
sub-wkC V M = sub-cons-wkC idS V M ∙ sub-idC M

-- 5.6: substituting under a lock commutes with crossing it
sub-↑ : ∀ {Δ Δ' κ A} (σ : Sub Δ Δ') (q : Pos κ (world Δ')) (V : Val Δ A) →
  subV (lockₛ σ q idR) (↑V (posW κ (wmS σ) q) V) ≡ ↑V q (subV σ V)
sub-↑ {κ = κ} σ q V = sub-ren-fuseV c₁ V refl ∙ sym (ren-sub-fuseV c₂ V refl)
  where
    c₁ : CompRS refl (dropL idR (posW κ (wmS σ) q)) (lockₛ σ q idR) (σ ↑ˢ q)
    c₁ .on-ne = funExt λ n → ren-idV _ ∙ sym (↑ˢ-ne σ q n)
    c₁ .on-world = ι-natW κ (wmS σ) q ∙ sym (wmS-↑ˢ σ q)
    c₂ : CompSR refl σ (dropL idR q) (σ ↑ˢ q)
    c₂ .on-ne = funExt λ n → sym (↑ˢ-ne σ q n)
    c₂ .on-world = sym (wmS-↑ˢ σ q)

-- 5.6: substituting under a lock commutes with open (by cases)
sub-openV : ∀ {Δ Δ' κ A} (σ : Sub Δ Δ') (q : Pos κ (world Δ')) (V : Val Δ ([ κ ] A)) →
  subV (lockₛ σ q idR) (openV V (posW κ (wmS σ) q)) ≡ openV (subV σ V) q
sub-openV σ q (ne n) = ren-idV _
sub-openV σ q (shut V) = refl

----------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 5.4: two substitutions

record CompSS {Θ₁ Θ₁' Θ₂ Θ₃} (e : Θ₁ ≡ Θ₁')
  (σ₁ : Sub Θ₁ Θ₂) (σ₂ : Sub Θ₂ Θ₃) (σ₁₂ : Sub Θ₁' Θ₃) : Type where
  field
    on-ne : ∀ {A} → PathP (λ i → Ne (e i) A → Val Θ₃ A) (λ n → subV σ₂ (subNe σ₁ n)) (subNe σ₁₂)
    on-world : PathP (λ i → W [ world (e i) , world Θ₃ ])
      (toW (wmS σ₁) W.⋆ toW (wmS σ₂)) (toW (wmS σ₁₂))

open CompSS

module _ {Θ₁ Θ₁' Θ₂ Θ₃} {e : Θ₁ ≡ Θ₁'} {σ₁ : Sub Θ₁ Θ₂} {σ₂ : Sub Θ₂ Θ₃} {σ₁₂ : Sub Θ₁' Θ₃} where

  private
    keep-ne : ∀ {B A} (n : Ne (Θ₁ , B) A) →
      subV (liftS σ₂) (subNe (liftS σ₁) n) ≡ liftV, (λ m → subV σ₂ (subNe σ₁ m)) n
    keep-ne here = refl
    keep-ne (wkv n) = cong (subV (liftS σ₂)) (wkS-ne σ₁ n) ∙ sub-liftS-wkV σ₂ (subNe σ₁ n)

    lock-ne : ∀ {κ A} (q : Pos κ (world Θ₃))
      (n : Ne (Θ₁ ⧀⟨ κ , posW κ (wmS σ₁) (posW κ (wmS σ₂) q) ⟩) A) →
      subV (lockₛ σ₂ q idR) (subNe (lockₛ σ₁ (posW κ (wmS σ₂) q) idR) n)
        ≡ liftV⧀ κ q (λ m → subV σ₂ (subNe σ₁ m)) n
    lock-ne {κ} q (up n) =
      cong (subV (lockₛ σ₂ q idR)) (ren-idV (↑V (posW κ (wmS σ₂) q) (subNe σ₁ n)))
      ∙ sub-↑ σ₂ q (subNe σ₁ n)
    lock-ne {κ} q (opn n) =
      cong (subV (lockₛ σ₂ q idR)) (ren-idV (openV (subNe σ₁ n) (posW κ (wmS σ₂) q)))
      ∙ sub-openV σ₂ q (subNe σ₁ n)
    lock-ne q (nm k) = refl

  CompSS-keep : ∀ {B} → CompSS e σ₁ σ₂ σ₁₂ →
    CompSS (λ i → e i , B) (liftS σ₁) (liftS σ₂) (liftS σ₁₂)
  CompSS-keep c .on-ne =
    funExt keep-ne ◁ (λ i → liftV, (λ {A} → c .on-ne {A} i)) ▷ sym (funExt (subNe-liftS σ₁₂))
  CompSS-keep c .on-world =
    cong₂ (λ g₁ g₂ → toW g₁ W.⋆ toW g₂) (wmS-wkS σ₁) (wmS-wkS σ₂)
    ◁ c .on-world ▷ cong toW (sym (wmS-wkS σ₁₂))

  CompSS-pt : ∀ {κ} → CompSS e σ₁ σ₂ σ₁₂ → (q : Pos κ (world Θ₃)) →
    PathP (λ i → Ey κ (world (e i)) (scope κ (world Θ₃) q))
      (posW κ (wmS σ₁) (posW κ (wmS σ₂) q) ,ˢ
        toW (smapW κ (wmS σ₁) (posW κ (wmS σ₂) q)) W.⋆ toW (smapW κ (wmS σ₂) q))
      (ptW κ (wmS σ₁₂) q)
  CompSS-pt {κ} c q = pt-comp κ (wmS σ₁) (wmS σ₂) (wmS σ₁₂) (c .on-world) q

  CompSS-lock : ∀ {κ} (c : CompSS e σ₁ σ₂ σ₁₂) (q : Pos κ (world Θ₃)) →
    CompSS (λ i → e i ⧀⟨ κ , CompSS-pt c q i .fst ⟩)
      (lockₛ σ₁ (posW κ (wmS σ₂) q) idR) (lockₛ σ₂ q idR) (lockₛ σ₁₂ q idR)
  CompSS-lock {κ} c q .on-ne =
    funExt (lock-ne q)
    ◁ (λ i → liftV⧀ κ {p = CompSS-pt c q i .fst} q (λ {A} → c .on-ne {A} i))
    ▷ sym (funExt (subNe-lockₛ σ₁₂ q))
  CompSS-lock c q .on-world i = CompSS-pt c q i .snd

CompSS-pts : ∀ {Θ₁ Θ₁' Θ₂ Θ₃} {e : Θ₁ ≡ Θ₁'}
  {σ₁ : Sub Θ₁ Θ₂} {σ₂ : Sub Θ₂ Θ₃} {σ₁₂ : Sub Θ₁' Θ₃}
  (μ : List Lk) → CompSS e σ₁ σ₂ σ₁₂ → (ps : WPos μ (world Θ₃)) →
  PathP (λ i → WPos μ (world (e i))) (wposW μ (wmS σ₁) (wposW μ (wmS σ₂) ps)) (wposW μ (wmS σ₁₂) ps)
CompSS-pts [] c ps = refl
CompSS-pts (κ ∷ []) c p i = CompSS-pt c p i .fst
CompSS-pts (κ ∷ μ@(_ ∷ _)) c (p ,ˢ ps) i =
  CompSS-pt c p i .fst ,ˢ CompSS-pts μ (CompSS-lock c p) ps i

CompSS-W : ∀ {Θ₁ Θ₁' Θ₂ Θ₃} {e : Θ₁ ≡ Θ₁'}
  {σ₁ : Sub Θ₁ Θ₂} {σ₂ : Sub Θ₂ Θ₃} {σ₁₂ : Sub Θ₁' Θ₃}
  (μ : List Lk) (c : CompSS e σ₁ σ₂ σ₁₂) (ps : WPos μ (world Θ₃)) →
  CompSS (λ i → e i ⧀*⟨ μ , CompSS-pts μ c ps i ⟩)
    (liftWS μ σ₁ (wposW μ (wmS σ₂) ps)) (liftWS μ σ₂ ps) (liftWS μ σ₁₂ ps)
CompSS-W [] c ps = c
CompSS-W (κ ∷ []) c p = CompSS-lock c p
CompSS-W (κ ∷ μ@(_ ∷ _)) c (p ,ˢ ps) = CompSS-W μ (CompSS-lock c p) ps

sub-fuseV : ∀ {Θ₁ Θ₁' Θ₂ Θ₃ A} {e : Θ₁ ≡ Θ₁'}
  {σ₁ : Sub Θ₁ Θ₂} {σ₂ : Sub Θ₂ Θ₃} {σ₁₂ : Sub Θ₁' Θ₃} → CompSS e σ₁ σ₂ σ₁₂ →
  (t : Val Θ₁ A) {t' : Val Θ₁' A} → PathP (λ i → Val (e i) A) t t' →
  subV σ₂ (subV σ₁ t) ≡ subV σ₁₂ t'
sub-fuseVs : ∀ {Θ₁ Θ₁' Θ₂ Θ₃ bs} {e : Θ₁ ≡ Θ₁'}
  {σ₁ : Sub Θ₁ Θ₂} {σ₂ : Sub Θ₂ Θ₃} {σ₁₂ : Sub Θ₁' Θ₃} → CompSS e σ₁ σ₂ σ₁₂ →
  (t : Vals Θ₁ bs) {t' : Vals Θ₁' bs} → PathP (λ i → Vals (e i) bs) t t' →
  subVs σ₂ (subVs σ₁ t) ≡ subVs σ₁₂ t'
sub-fuseC : ∀ {Θ₁ Θ₁' Θ₂ Θ₃ B} {e : Θ₁ ≡ Θ₁'}
  {σ₁ : Sub Θ₁ Θ₂} {σ₂ : Sub Θ₂ Θ₃} {σ₁₂ : Sub Θ₁' Θ₃} → CompSS e σ₁ σ₂ σ₁₂ →
  (t : Comp Θ₁ B) {t' : Comp Θ₁' B} → PathP (λ i → Comp (e i) B) t t' →
  subC σ₂ (subC σ₁ t) ≡ subC σ₁₂ t'

private
  ssV : ∀ {Θ₁ Θ₂ Θ₃ A} {σ₁ : Sub Θ₁ Θ₂} {σ₂ : Sub Θ₂ Θ₃} {σ₁₂ : Sub Θ₁ Θ₃} →
    CompSS refl σ₁ σ₂ σ₁₂ → (t : Val Θ₁ A) → subV σ₂ (subV σ₁ t) ≡ subV σ₁₂ t
  ssVs : ∀ {Θ₁ Θ₂ Θ₃ bs} {σ₁ : Sub Θ₁ Θ₂} {σ₂ : Sub Θ₂ Θ₃} {σ₁₂ : Sub Θ₁ Θ₃} →
    CompSS refl σ₁ σ₂ σ₁₂ → (t : Vals Θ₁ bs) → subVs σ₂ (subVs σ₁ t) ≡ subVs σ₁₂ t
  ssC : ∀ {Θ₁ Θ₂ Θ₃ B} {σ₁ : Sub Θ₁ Θ₂} {σ₂ : Sub Θ₂ Θ₃} {σ₁₂ : Sub Θ₁ Θ₃} →
    CompSS refl σ₁ σ₂ σ₁₂ → (t : Comp Θ₁ B) → subC σ₂ (subC σ₁ t) ≡ subC σ₁₂ t

  ssV c (ne n) i = c .on-ne i n
  ssV c tt = refl
  ssV c (inl V) = cong inl (ssV c V)
  ssV c (inr V) = cong inr (ssV c V)
  ssV c (pair V V') = cong₂ pair (ssV c V) (ssV c V')
  ssV c (thunk M) = cong thunk (ssC c M)
  ssV {σ₁ = σ₁} {σ₂} {σ₁₂} c (const x) =
    cong const (cmapW-seq (wmS σ₁) (wmS σ₂) (wmS σ₁₂) (c .on-world) x)
  ssV c (shut V) = cong shut (funExt λ q →
    sub-fuseV (CompSS-lock c q) (V _) (λ i → V (CompSS-pt c q i .fst)))

  ssVs c []ᵥ = refl
  ssVs c (V ∷ᵥ vs) = cong₂ _∷ᵥ_ (ssV c V) (ssVs c vs)

  ssC c (return V) = cong return (ssV c V)
  ssC c (M to N) = cong₂ _to_ (ssC c M) (ssC (CompSS-keep c) N)
  ssC c (force V) = cong force (ssV c V)
  ssC c (case V M) = cong₂ case (ssV c V) (ssC (CompSS-keep (CompSS-keep c)) M)
  ssC c (case₊ V M N) =
    cong₃ case₊ (ssV c V) (ssC (CompSS-keep c) M) (ssC (CompSS-keep c) N)
  ssC c (absurd V) = cong absurd (ssV c V)
  ssC c (lam M) = cong lam (ssC (CompSS-keep c) M)
  ssC c (app M V) = cong₂ app (ssC c M) (ssV c V)
  ssC c (op o vs k) = cong₂ (op o) (ssVs c vs) (funExt λ a → funExt λ ps →
    sub-fuseC (CompSS-W (slot o a) c ps) (k a _) (λ i → k a (CompSS-pts (slot o a) c ps i)))

sub-fuseV {Θ₁} {Θ₃ = Θ₃} {A = A} {σ₁ = σ₁} {σ₂} c t tp =
  J-tele (λ Θ → Val Θ A)
    (λ Θ' e' t' → (σ : Sub Θ' Θ₃) → CompSS e' σ₁ σ₂ σ → subV σ₂ (subV σ₁ t) ≡ subV σ t')
    (λ σ c' → ssV c' t) _ tp _ c
sub-fuseVs {Θ₁} {Θ₃ = Θ₃} {bs = bs} {σ₁ = σ₁} {σ₂} c t tp =
  J-tele (λ Θ → Vals Θ bs)
    (λ Θ' e' t' → (σ : Sub Θ' Θ₃) → CompSS e' σ₁ σ₂ σ → subVs σ₂ (subVs σ₁ t) ≡ subVs σ t')
    (λ σ c' → ssVs c' t) _ tp _ c
sub-fuseC {Θ₁} {Θ₃ = Θ₃} {B = B} {σ₁ = σ₁} {σ₂} c t tp =
  J-tele (λ Θ → Comp Θ B)
    (λ Θ' e' t' → (σ : Sub Θ' Θ₃) → CompSS e' σ₁ σ₂ σ → subC σ₂ (subC σ₁ t) ≡ subC σ t')
    (λ σ c' → ssC c' t) _ tp _ c

----------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 5.5: extensionality (5.2 with the identity renaming, then ren-id)

record AgreeSS {Θ₁ Θ₂ Θ'} (e : Θ₁ ≡ Θ₂) (σ₁ : Sub Θ₁ Θ') (σ₂ : Sub Θ₂ Θ') : Type where
  field
    on-ne : ∀ {A} → PathP (λ i → Ne (e i) A → Val Θ' A) (subNe σ₁) (subNe σ₂)
    on-world : PathP (λ i → W [ world (e i) , world Θ' ]) (toW (wmS σ₁)) (toW (wmS σ₂))

open AgreeSS

AgreeSS→CompRS : ∀ {Θ₁ Θ₂ Θ'} {e : Θ₁ ≡ Θ₂} {σ₁ : Sub Θ₁ Θ'} {σ₂ : Sub Θ₂ Θ'} →
  AgreeSS e σ₁ σ₂ → CompRS e idR σ₁ σ₂
AgreeSS→CompRS ag .on-ne = ag .on-ne
AgreeSS→CompRS {σ₁ = σ₁} ag .on-world = W.⋆IdL (toW (wmS σ₁)) ◁ ag .on-world

sub-extV : ∀ {Θ₁ Θ₂ Θ' A} {e : Θ₁ ≡ Θ₂} {σ₁ : Sub Θ₁ Θ'} {σ₂ : Sub Θ₂ Θ'} → AgreeSS e σ₁ σ₂ →
  (t₁ : Val Θ₁ A) {t₂ : Val Θ₂ A} → PathP (λ i → Val (e i) A) t₁ t₂ → subV σ₁ t₁ ≡ subV σ₂ t₂
sub-extV {σ₁ = σ₁} ag t₁ tp =
  cong (subV σ₁) (sym (ren-idV t₁)) ∙ sub-ren-fuseV (AgreeSS→CompRS ag) t₁ tp

sub-extVs : ∀ {Θ₁ Θ₂ Θ' bs} {e : Θ₁ ≡ Θ₂} {σ₁ : Sub Θ₁ Θ'} {σ₂ : Sub Θ₂ Θ'} → AgreeSS e σ₁ σ₂ →
  (t₁ : Vals Θ₁ bs) {t₂ : Vals Θ₂ bs} → PathP (λ i → Vals (e i) bs) t₁ t₂ → subVs σ₁ t₁ ≡ subVs σ₂ t₂
sub-extVs {σ₁ = σ₁} ag t₁ tp =
  cong (subVs σ₁) (sym (ren-idVs t₁)) ∙ sub-ren-fuseVs (AgreeSS→CompRS ag) t₁ tp

sub-extC : ∀ {Θ₁ Θ₂ Θ' B} {e : Θ₁ ≡ Θ₂} {σ₁ : Sub Θ₁ Θ'} {σ₂ : Sub Θ₂ Θ'} → AgreeSS e σ₁ σ₂ →
  (t₁ : Comp Θ₁ B) {t₂ : Comp Θ₂ B} → PathP (λ i → Comp (e i) B) t₁ t₂ → subC σ₁ t₁ ≡ subC σ₂ t₂
sub-extC {σ₁ = σ₁} ag t₁ tp =
  cong (subC σ₁) (sym (ren-idC t₁)) ∙ sub-ren-fuseC (AgreeSS→CompRS ag) t₁ tp

----------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 5.6: substituting into a one- and a two-variable substitution
-- (both sides fuse to σ ,ₛ subV σ V)

sub-sub₁ : ∀ {Θ Θ' A B} (σ : Sub Θ Θ') (N : Comp (Θ , A) B) (V : Val Θ A) →
  subC σ (sub₁ N V) ≡ sub₁ (subC (liftS σ) N) (subV σ V)
sub-sub₁ σ N V = sub-fuseC c₁ N refl ∙ sym (sub-fuseC c₂ N refl)
  where
    c₁ : CompSS refl (idS ,ₛ V) σ (σ ,ₛ subV σ V)
    c₁ .on-ne = funExt λ { here → refl ; (wkv n) → refl }
    c₁ .on-world = W.⋆IdL _
    c₂ : CompSS refl (liftS σ) (idS ,ₛ subV σ V) (σ ,ₛ subV σ V)
    c₂ .on-ne = funExt λ
      { here → refl
      ; (wkv n) → cong (subV (idS ,ₛ subV σ V)) (wkS-ne σ n) ∙ sub-wkV _ _ }
    c₂ .on-world = W.⋆IdR _ ∙ cong toW (wmS-wkS σ)

sub-sub₂ : ∀ {Θ Θ' A A' B} (σ : Sub Θ Θ') (M : Comp (Θ , A , A') B) (V : Val Θ A) (V' : Val Θ A') →
  subC σ (sub₂ M V V') ≡ sub₂ (subC (liftS (liftS σ)) M) (subV σ V) (subV σ V')
sub-sub₂ σ M V V' = sub-fuseC c₁ M refl ∙ sym (sub-fuseC c₂ M refl)
  where
    c₁ : CompSS refl (idS ,ₛ V ,ₛ V') σ (σ ,ₛ subV σ V ,ₛ subV σ V')
    c₁ .on-ne = funExt λ { here → refl ; (wkv here) → refl ; (wkv (wkv n)) → refl }
    c₁ .on-world = W.⋆IdL _
    c₂ : CompSS refl (liftS (liftS σ)) (idS ,ₛ subV σ V ,ₛ subV σ V') (σ ,ₛ subV σ V ,ₛ subV σ V')
    c₂ .on-ne = funExt λ
      { here → refl
      ; (wkv here) → refl
      ; (wkv (wkv n)) →
          cong (subV (idS ,ₛ subV σ V ,ₛ subV σ V')) (wkS-ne (wkS σ) n ∙ cong wkV (wkS-ne σ n))
          ∙ sub-cons-wkV (idS ,ₛ subV σ V) (subV σ V') (wkV (subNe σ n))
          ∙ sub-wkV (subV σ V) (subNe σ n) }
    c₂ .on-world = W.⋆IdR _ ∙ cong toW (wmS-wkS (wkS σ) ∙ wmS-wkS σ)

----------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 5.6: substituting under a frame pushed across a word (op-to, op-app)

private
  renNe-dropW : ∀ {Θ Δ A} (ρ : Ren Θ Δ) (μ : List Lk) (ps : WPos μ (world Δ)) (n : Ne Θ A) →
    renNe (dropW idR μ ps) (renNe ρ n) ≡ renNe (dropW ρ μ ps) n
  renNe-dropW ρ [] ps n = refl
  renNe-dropW ρ (κ ∷ []) p n = refl
  renNe-dropW ρ (κ ∷ μ@(_ ∷ _)) (p ,ˢ ps) n =
    sym (renNe-dropW (dropL idR p) μ ps (renNe ρ n)) ∙ renNe-dropW (dropL ρ p) μ ps n

  wm-dropW : ∀ {Θ Δ} (ρ : Ren Θ Δ) (μ : List Lk) (ps : WPos μ (world Δ)) →
    toW (wm ρ) W.⋆ toW (wm (dropW idR μ ps)) ≡ toW (wm (dropW ρ μ ps))
  wm-dropW ρ [] ps = W.⋆IdR _
  wm-dropW ρ (κ ∷ []) p = sym (toW-⋆ (wm ρ) (mapW _))
  wm-dropW ρ (κ ∷ μ@(_ ∷ _)) (p ,ˢ ps) =
    cong (toW (wm ρ) W.⋆_) (sym (wm-dropW (dropL idR p) μ ps))
    ∙ sym (W.⋆Assoc _ _ _)
    ∙ cong (W._⋆ toW (wm (dropW idR μ ps))) (sym (toW-⋆ (wm ρ) (mapW _)))
    ∙ wm-dropW (dropL ρ p) μ ps

  -- ρ then across a word is ρ followed by dropW
  Composite-dropW : ∀ {Θ Δ} (ρ : Ren Θ Δ) (μ : List Lk) (ps : WPos μ (world Δ)) →
    Composite refl ρ (dropW idR μ ps) (dropW ρ μ ps)
  Composite-dropW ρ μ ps .on-ne = funExt (renNe-dropW ρ μ ps)
  Composite-dropW ρ μ ps .on-world = wm-dropW ρ μ ps

  dropW-fuseV : ∀ {Θ Δ A} (ρ : Ren Θ Δ) (μ : List Lk) (ps : WPos μ (world Δ)) (V : Val Θ A) →
    renV (dropW idR μ ps) (renV ρ V) ≡ renV (dropW ρ μ ps) V
  dropW-fuseV ρ μ ps V = ren-fuseV (Composite-dropW ρ μ ps) V refl

-- σ, then across the locks of a word
↑ˢW : ∀ {Θ Δ} (μ : List Lk) → Sub Θ Δ → (ps : WPos μ (world Δ)) → Sub Θ (Δ ⧀*⟨ μ , ps ⟩)
↑ˢW [] σ _ = σ
↑ˢW (κ ∷ []) σ p = σ ↑ˢ p
↑ˢW (κ ∷ μ@(_ ∷ _)) σ (p ,ˢ ps) = ↑ˢW μ (σ ↑ˢ p) ps

↑ˢW-ne : ∀ {Θ Δ A} (μ : List Lk) (σ : Sub Θ Δ) (ps : WPos μ (world Δ)) (n : Ne Θ A) →
  subNe (↑ˢW μ σ ps) n ≡ renV (dropW idR μ ps) (subNe σ n)
↑ˢW-ne [] σ ps n = sym (ren-idV _)
↑ˢW-ne (κ ∷ []) σ p n = ↑ˢ-ne σ p n
↑ˢW-ne (κ ∷ μ@(_ ∷ _)) σ (p ,ˢ ps) n =
  ↑ˢW-ne μ (σ ↑ˢ p) ps n
  ∙ cong (renV (dropW idR μ ps)) (↑ˢ-ne σ p n)
  ∙ dropW-fuseV (dropL idR p) μ ps (subNe σ n)

wmS-↑ˢW : ∀ {Θ Δ} (μ : List Lk) (σ : Sub Θ Δ) (ps : WPos μ (world Δ)) →
  toW (wmS (↑ˢW μ σ ps)) ≡ toW (wmS σ) W.⋆ toW (wm (dropW idR μ ps))
wmS-↑ˢW [] σ ps = sym (W.⋆IdR _)
wmS-↑ˢW (κ ∷ []) σ p = wmS-↑ˢ σ p
wmS-↑ˢW (κ ∷ μ@(_ ∷ _)) σ (p ,ˢ ps) =
  wmS-↑ˢW μ (σ ↑ˢ p) ps
  ∙ cong (W._⋆ toW (wm (dropW idR μ ps))) (wmS-↑ˢ σ p)
  ∙ W.⋆Assoc _ _ _
  ∙ cong (toW (wmS σ) W.⋆_) (wm-dropW (dropL idR p) μ ps)

private
  -- across the word, then under it, is σ then across the word
  liftWS-dropW-ne : ∀ {Θ Θ' A} (μ : List Lk) (σ : Sub Θ Θ') (ps : WPos μ (world Θ')) (n : Ne Θ A) →
    subNe (liftWS μ σ ps) (renNe (dropW idR μ (wposW μ (wmS σ) ps)) n)
      ≡ renV (dropW idR μ ps) (subNe σ n)
  liftWS-dropW-ne [] σ ps n = sym (ren-idV _)
  liftWS-dropW-ne (κ ∷ []) σ p n = ren-idV _
  liftWS-dropW-ne (κ ∷ μ@(_ ∷ _)) σ (p ,ˢ ps) n =
    cong (subNe (liftWS μ (lockₛ σ p idR) ps))
      (sym (renNe-dropW (dropL idR (posW κ (wmS σ) p)) μ (wposW μ (smapW κ (wmS σ) p) ps) n))
    ∙ liftWS-dropW-ne μ (lockₛ σ p idR) ps (up n)
    ∙ cong (renV (dropW idR μ ps)) (ren-idV _)
    ∙ dropW-fuseV (dropL idR p) μ ps (subNe σ n)

  liftWS-dropW-world : ∀ {Θ Θ'} (μ : List Lk) (σ : Sub Θ Θ') (ps : WPos μ (world Θ')) →
    toW (wm (dropW idR μ (wposW μ (wmS σ) ps))) W.⋆ toW (wmS (liftWS μ σ ps))
      ≡ toW (wmS σ) W.⋆ toW (wm (dropW idR μ ps))
  liftWS-dropW-world [] σ ps = W.⋆IdL _ ∙ sym (W.⋆IdR _)
  liftWS-dropW-world (κ ∷ []) σ p = ι-natW κ (wmS σ) p
  liftWS-dropW-world (κ ∷ μ@(_ ∷ _)) σ (p ,ˢ ps) =
    cong (W._⋆ toW (wmS (liftWS μ (lockₛ σ p idR) ps)))
      (sym (wm-dropW (dropL idR (posW κ (wmS σ) p)) μ (wposW μ (smapW κ (wmS σ) p) ps)))
    ∙ W.⋆Assoc _ _ _
    ∙ cong (ι κ _ (posW κ (wmS σ) p) W.⋆_) (liftWS-dropW-world μ (lockₛ σ p idR) ps)
    ∙ sym (W.⋆Assoc _ _ _)
    ∙ cong (W._⋆ toW (wm (dropW idR μ ps))) (ι-natW κ (wmS σ) p)
    ∙ W.⋆Assoc _ _ _
    ∙ cong (toW (wmS σ) W.⋆_) (wm-dropW (dropL idR p) μ ps)

CompRS-dropW : ∀ {Θ Θ'} (μ : List Lk) (σ : Sub Θ Θ') (ps : WPos μ (world Θ')) →
  CompRS refl (dropW idR μ (wposW μ (wmS σ) ps)) (liftWS μ σ ps) (↑ˢW μ σ ps)
CompRS-dropW μ σ ps .on-ne = funExt λ n → liftWS-dropW-ne μ σ ps n ∙ sym (↑ˢW-ne μ σ ps n)
CompRS-dropW μ σ ps .on-world = liftWS-dropW-world μ σ ps ∙ sym (wmS-↑ˢW μ σ ps)

CompSR-dropW : ∀ {Θ Θ'} (μ : List Lk) (σ : Sub Θ Θ') (ps : WPos μ (world Θ')) →
  CompSR refl σ (dropW idR μ ps) (↑ˢW μ σ ps)
CompSR-dropW μ σ ps .on-ne = funExt λ n → sym (↑ˢW-ne μ σ ps n)
CompSR-dropW μ σ ps .on-world = sym (wmS-↑ˢW μ σ ps)

-- 5.6 (op-app): a value pushed across a word, then substituted under it
sub-dropWV : ∀ {Θ Θ' A} (σ : Sub Θ Θ') (μ : List Lk) (ps : WPos μ (world Θ')) (V : Val Θ A) →
  subV (liftWS μ σ ps) (renV (dropW idR μ (wposW μ (wmS σ) ps)) V)
    ≡ renV (dropW idR μ ps) (subV σ V)
sub-dropWV σ μ ps V =
  sub-ren-fuseV (CompRS-dropW μ σ ps) V refl ∙ sym (ren-sub-fuseV (CompSR-dropW μ σ ps) V refl)

-- 5.6 (op-to): a continuation pushed across a word, then substituted under it
sub-dropW : ∀ {Θ Θ' A B} (σ : Sub Θ Θ') (μ : List Lk) (ps : WPos μ (world Θ')) (N : Comp (Θ , A) B) →
  subC (liftS (liftWS μ σ ps)) (renC (keep (dropW idR μ (wposW μ (wmS σ) ps))) N)
    ≡ renC (keep (dropW idR μ ps)) (subC (liftS σ) N)
sub-dropW σ μ ps N =
  sub-ren-fuseC (CompRS-keep (CompRS-dropW μ σ ps)) N refl
  ∙ sym (ren-sub-fuseC (CompSR-keep (CompSR-dropW μ σ ps)) N refl)
